title: Strappado
summary: STRAPPADO, noun A military punishment formerly practiced. It consisted in drawing an offender to the top of a beam and letting him fall, by which means a limb was sometimes dislocated. STRAPPADO, verb

inlines.v: STRAPPADO, noun A military punishment formerly practiced. It consisted in drawing an offender to the top of a beam and letting him fall, by which means a limb was sometimes dislocated. STRAPPADO, verb transitive To torture.
